ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmonious? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmonious.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Harmonious.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmonious.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants and its resources.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Animals and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Heat and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of heat in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dangers of heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

4. C — Ice melting to water

7. B — 100 °C

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.

10. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
